build_network: build a Haiku MLP network factory that approximates Q-values for a given number of hidden units and actions
create_sequence_accumulator: create a sequence accumulator that gathers timesteps and actions into fixed-length sequences for RL training
run_online_q_lambda_agent: run an online Q-lambda agent trained on BSuite's Catch environment with configurable hyperparameters
calculate_q_lambda_loss: calculate the Q-lambda loss with masked TD errors over action-timestep sequences for neural network training
execute_rl_training_loop: execute a complete RL training and evaluation loop with the agent, environment, and sequence accumulator
